title: 第11章 石岗战双猬 血战见真情第12章 柔藤寻灵药 赤手伏灵犬
lines: 黎明时分，天光微亮，晨曦洒在无尽东海的海面之上，也照亮了整座神秘而广袤的琉璃岛。
这座未知的荒岛辽阔无比，罗止正与李紫云一路走来，也仅仅探索了最外围的冰山一角，更深处的地域与潜藏的凶险，远比他们此刻所见更加浩瀚莫测。
两人从白沙滩出发，手中仅有一根磨得光滑的长棍、一把简陋的木弓与十支木箭，除此之外再无他物。
他们一步步踏入无尽东海沿海密林——这片紧贴海岸线而生的林地，只是琉璃岛最外围的地带，也是两人目前为止最为熟悉的求生之地。
而这片沿海密林的东边区域，便是碧叶林。
碧叶林之内又分东南西北中五处地域，各自地形迥异，凶险不同：
最东边为视野开阔的东海空坪，
正南方为溪水潺潺的清涟溪湾，
西侧为藤蔓密布的柔藤漫坡，
而最北端，则是一处两人从未踏足的全新地带。
一路自东向南，再由南向西，两人的脚步平稳而坚定。
清晨的风带着海水的湿润，拂过林间枝叶，发出沙沙的轻响。
行至半途，潺潺流水声由远及近，正是他们熟悉的清涟溪湾。
溪水清澈见底，缓缓流淌，是这片密林里难得的安稳之地。
罗止正看向身旁面露疲色的李紫云，语气放缓，温声开口：“先停下来喝点水，恢复点力气再走。”
李紫云轻蹙秀眉，抬手揉了揉发酸的腿腹，带着几分倦意轻轻颔首，声音软软的：“好。”
她蹲在溪边，双手捧起清凉的溪水，小口小口地饮下。
甘甜的水流滑过喉咙，驱散了清晨的寒意与倦意。
罗止正则从腰间取出银月水囊，俯身灌满溪水，自己仰头喝了几口，随后便站在一旁凝神警戒，目光锐利地扫过四周树丛，语气沉稳：“我守着，你歇片刻。”
短暂的休息过后，两人再次上路。
穿过清涟溪湾，他们继续西行，进入藤蔓交错的柔藤漫坡边缘，没有过多停留，径直朝着碧叶林最深处、最北端的方向前行。
等到脚步终于踏入那片地势抬高、开阔干燥的地带时，日头已经爬到了天空正中，正是正午时分。
这片天然石质地坡地面坚硬平整，由青石与褐色土块混合而成，踩上去碎石滚动，发出清脆的碎响。
最醒目的，是那些裸露在外的古木根系。
数人合抱的巨木扎根于此，粗壮的根须如同虬龙般破土而出，纵横交错、盘结缠绕，有的隆起半米多高，如同天然壁垒；有的横铺在地，形成高低不平的走道。
这里，正是碧叶林北端——盘根石岗。
此地坐落于无尽东海沿岸密林东侧，与无尽东海沿岸浅滩直线相距约十一公里。
两人驻足环顾，将周遭地形细细看在眼里。
乱石与虬结的古根遍地交错，景象格外分明。
罗止正望着四周，语气平静又笃定：“乱石交错，古根盘结，往后便称此处为盘根石岗。”
李紫云微微点头，轻声应和，语气轻柔：“嗯，很是贴切。”
整片石岗干燥通风，视野通透。
站在高处，甚至能远眺到东海海面的波光，是碧叶林中视野最好的一片区域。
风从北方吹来，带着干燥的凉意，卷起地上的枯叶与细沙，在盘根之间轻轻打转。
空气中没有密林深处的潮湿腐味，只有岩石的冷硬与枯木的干涩，安静得只剩下风声与两人的呼吸声。
越是安静，越让人心里发紧。
罗止正带着李紫云，小心翼翼地穿行在交错的树根之间。
这里视野太好，几乎没有藏身之处，每一步都必须加倍谨慎。
两人压低身形，贴着巨大的树根缓慢移动，目光警惕地扫视着四周。
谁也没有留意脚下。
李紫云一步落下，脚尖无意间踢到一片被落叶半掩的松软土堆。
下一秒——
两声低沉的嗡鸣同时炸响！
落叶轰然翻飞，尘土四溅！
content_en:
At dawn, the sky was slightly bright, and the morning rays shone on the endless East China Sea, illuminating the entire mysterious and vast Liuli Island.
This unknown desert island is extremely vast. Luo Zhizheng and Li Ziyun have only explored the tip of the outermost iceberg along the way. The deeper areas and hidden dangers are far more vast and unpredictable than what they see now.
The two set out from the white sand beach with only a long polished stick, a simple wooden bow and ten wooden arrows in their hands, and nothing else.
Step by step, they stepped into the dense forest along the coast of the endless East China Sea - this woodland that grows close to the coastline is only the outermost area of ​​Liuli Island, and it is also the most familiar place for survival for the two of them so far.
The eastern area of ​​this coastal dense forest is the Biye Forest.
The Biye Forest is divided into five areas: southeast, northwest, and middle. Each has a very different terrain and different dangers:
The easternmost part is the East China Sea Kongping with a wide view.
Directly to the south is Qinglian Creek Bay with gurgling water.
On the west side is a soft slope covered with dense vines.
The northernmost point is a brand new area that the two of them have never set foot on.
All the way from east to south, and then from south to west, the two of them walked steadily and firmly.
The morning wind brings the moisture of the sea water, blowing through the branches and leaves in the forest, making a soft rustling sound.
Halfway through the journey, the sound of gurgling water came closer and closer. It was the Qinglian Creek Bay they were familiar with.
The stream is crystal clear and flows slowly, making it a rare and peaceful place in this dense forest.
Luo Zhi was looking at Li Ziyun who was looking tired next to him. His tone slowed down and he spoke in a warm voice: "Stop and drink some water first to regain some strength before leaving."
Li Ziyun lightly frowned, raised his hand to rub his sore legs, nodded slightly tiredly, and said in a soft voice, "Okay."
She squatted by the stream, held the cool stream water in her hands, and drank it in small sips.
The sweet water flowed down the throat, dispelling the chill and fatigue of the morning.
Luo Zhizheng took out the silver moon water bag from his waist, leaned over and filled it with water from the stream. He raised his head and drank a few sips. Then he stood aside and was alert, his eyes sharply scanning the surrounding trees, and his tone was calm: "I will guard, you take a rest for a while."
After a short rest, the two hit the road again.
Passing through Qinglian Creek Bay, they continued westward and entered the edge of the soft vine slope with intertwined vines. Without stopping too much, they headed straight towards the deepest and northernmost part of the Blue Leaf Forest.
When we finally stepped into the elevated, open and dry area, the sun had climbed to the middle of the sky, and it was exactly noon.
This natural stone sloping ground is hard and flat, made of a mixture of bluestone and brown soil. When you step on it, the gravel rolls and makes a crisp crunching sound.
The most eye-catching thing is the exposed roots of ancient trees.
A giant tree hugged by several people is rooted here, and its thick roots break out of the ground like a horned dragon, crisscrossing and twisting. Some are raised more than half a meter high, like natural barriers; some are spread across the ground, forming uneven walkways.
Here is the northern end of Biyelin - Pangenshigan.
This place is located on the east side of the dense forest along the coast of the Endless East China Sea, about 11 kilometers away from the shoals along the coast of the Endless East China Sea.
The two stopped and looked around, taking in the surrounding terrain carefully.
Rocks and ancient roots intersect everywhere, making the scene particularly clear.
Luo Zhi was looking around, with a calm and determined tone: "The rocks are intertwined and the ancient roots are entangled. From now on, this place will be called the entangled rock hill."
Li Ziyun nodded slightly, responded softly, and said softly: "Yes, that's very appropriate."
The entire stone hillock is dry and ventilated, with a clear view.
Standing on a high place, you can even see the waves of the East China Sea. It is the area with the best view in the green leaf forest.
The wind blows from the north, bringing with it a dry coolness, picking up the dead leaves and fine sand on the ground, gently swirling among the roots.
There was no damp and rotten smell in the deep forest, only the cold hardness of the rocks and the dryness of the dead trees. It was so quiet that only the sound of the wind and the breathing of the two people remained.
The quieter it is, the more heart-wrenching it is.
Luo Zhi was taking Li Ziyun carefully through the intertwined tree roots.
The view here is so good, there is almost no hiding place, so every step must be done with caution.
The two lowered their bodies and moved slowly against the huge tree roots, scanning the surroundings with vigilance.
No one paid attention to their feet.
Li Ziyun fell down in one step and accidentally kicked a soft mound of soil half-covered by fallen leaves with his toes.
The next second——
Two low buzzing sounds exploded at the same time!
The fallen leaves flew into the air and dust flew everywhere!
